## 1
### Airports
```{r}
airports <- read_csv(
  "airports.csv",
  col_types = cols_only(
    IATA_CODE = col_character(),
    CITY      = col_character(),
    STATE     = col_character(),
    LATITUDE  = col_double(),
    LONGITUDE = col_double()
  )
)
airports
```
### Airlines
```{r}
airlines <- read_csv("airlines.csv")
airlines
```
### flights
```{r}
# lista que vai acumular as estatísticas suficientes de cada bloco
lista_stats <- list()
processa_bloco <- function(bloco, pos) {
  stats_bloco <- bloco |>
    filter(substr(DESTINATION_AIRPORT, 1, 1) != "1") |>
    drop_na() |>
    group_by(DESTINATION_AIRPORT) |>
    summarise(
      soma_atraso = sum(ARRIVAL_DELAY),
      n_voos      = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  # acumula na lista 
  lista_stats[[length(lista_stats) + 1]] <<- stats_bloco
}
read_csv_chunked(
  "flights.csv",
  callback  = SideEffectChunkCallback$new(processa_bloco),
  chunk_size = 1e6,
  col_types = cols_only(
    DESTINATION_AIRPORT = col_character(),
    ARRIVAL_DELAY        = col_double()
  )
)
# combina as estatísticas suficientes de todos os blocos
flights <- bind_rows(lista_stats) |>
  group_by(DESTINATION_AIRPORT) |>
  summarise(
    soma_atraso = sum(soma_atraso),
    n_voos      = sum(n_voos),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(atraso_medio = soma_atraso / n_voos)
flights
```
# 2. Join 
### Aeroportos em `flights` mas ausentes em `airports`
```{r}
aeroportos_ausentes <- flights |>
  anti_join(airports, by = c("DESTINATION_AIRPORT" = "IATA_CODE"))
aeroportos_ausentes
```
```{r}
flights <- flights |>
  left_join(airports, by = c("DESTINATION_AIRPORT" = "IATA_CODE"))
flights
```
## 3.aeroportos por estado
```{r}
aeroportos_por_estado <- airports |>
  count(STATE, name = "n_aeroportos") |>
  arrange(desc(n_aeroportos))
aeroportos_por_estado
```
## 4. Mapa dos atrasos por aeroporto
```{r}
this <- flights |>
  filter(!is.na(LATITUDE), !is.na(LONGITUDE)) |>
  leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  addMarkers(
    lng   = ~LONGITUDE,
    lat   = ~LATITUDE,
    popup = ~paste0(
      DESTINATION_AIRPORT, " - ", CITY, "/", STATE,
      "<br>Atraso médio: ", round(atraso_medio, 1), " min"
    )
  )
```
```{r mapa-leaflet-run}
mapa_dados <- flights |>
  filter(!is.na(LATITUDE), !is.na(LONGITUDE))

estados <- map_data("state")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = estados,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "grey95", color = "grey70"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = mapa_dados,
    aes(x = LONGITUDE, y = LATITUDE, color = atraso_medio),
    size = 2, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "steelblue", mid = "grey90", high = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0, name = "Atraso médio\n(min)"
  ) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = c(-130, -65), ylim = c(24, 50)) +
  labs(
    title = "Atraso médio de chegada por aeroporto de destino",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
